text: Program Description 1. Training Objectives Our full-time master's degree program in Engineering Management (MEM, Logistics Engineering and Management) is oriented towards solving related issues in the logistics and supply chain management support fields such as the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry, the efficient and intensive commercial circulation system, and the transformation of digital information technology. It aims to cultivate strong professional skills and professional ethics, and master the basic theories, tools, and methods of logistics engineering and management, Familiar with the current situation and cutting-edge trends in the development of international logistics engineering and management, with the ability to solve complex problems in the field of actual logistics engineering and management, as well as the ability to plan, organize, coordinate, and make decisions, and able to meet the needs of high-level, applied, and composite professional and professional talents in the field of modern logistics and supply chain. 2. Training Method and Length of Study The tutorial responsibility system is implemented, and curriculum learning and professional practice can be conducted in a cross manner. The course learning adopts the credit system, and the required credits should be completed before applying for the defense of the degree thesis. Professional practice time shall not be less than half a year. The length of study for full-time professional master's degree graduates is generally 3 years, with a maximum of 5 years. 3. Professional Core Courses Serial Number Course No Course name credit Credit hours 1 ITIN198_ 20T Engineering Ethics 2 32 2 ITIN199_ 20T Operations Research 2 32 3 ITIN200_ 20T Applied Statistics 2 32 4 ITIN201_ 20T Logistics and Supply Chain Management 2 32 5 ITIN202_ 20T Operation Management 2 32 6 ITIN203_ 20T Systems Engineering 2 32 7 ITIN204_ 20T Logistics System Theory 2 32 8 ITIN205_ 20T Logistics System Modeling and Simulation 2 32 4. Dissertation The degree thesis should be completed independently under the guidance of a mentor, and the actual workload of the thesis is generally not less than 1 year. The selected topic of the paper should come from the actual situation of the enterprise, have a clear engineering background and application value, have certain technical difficulty and progressiveness, and can reflect the author's ability to comprehensively apply scientific theories, methods and technical means to solve practical logistics problems. The number of words in the body of the thesis shall not be less than 20000 words; There are no less than 30 references, mainly from the past 5 years. 5. Degree Award Graduates who have completed the course study and required courses according to the personal training plan within the time limit specified by the length of schooling, passed the examination, and passed the defense of their degree thesis are granted graduation and a graduation certificate is issued. Graduate students who pass the course study and required courses specified in their personal training plan and pass the examination, but fail to pass the defense of their degree thesis, will be treated as completing their studies and issued a certificate of completion. Graduate students who have completed more than one and a half years of study and dropped out of school will complete the courses and required courses required by the personal training plan, pass the examination, and be issued a certificate of completion.
